description: Zoning districts for the Snyderville Basin Planning District (the western unincorporated Basin regulated by Title 10). The operational zoning layer behind the county Interactive Zoning Map.
publisher: Summit County GIS (ArcGIS Online org gyfpgFh2Wj2gglYD)
license: Summit County GIS (no explicit license; public)
notes: 34 zone polygons. THE Basin land-use/zoning layer - pair with plans/ (Basin GP) + ordinances/ (Title 10). Query narrowly; do not bulk-fetch.

description: Zoning districts for the Eastern Summit County Planning District (the eastern unincorporated area regulated by Title 11).
publisher: Summit County GIS (ArcGIS Online org gyfpgFh2Wj2gglYD)
notes: 44 zone polygons. THE East Side zoning layer - pair with the Eastern GP + Title 11.

description: Parcels enrolled in agricultural protection (ag-preservation overlay) in unincorporated Summit County.
Ridgeline protection lines constraining hillside/skyline development in the Basin.

layer: Lower Silver Creek Soils Overlay Zone
description: Soils/contamination overlay zone near Lower Silver Creek constraining development.
Parcel boundaries with the county's own parcel attributes (the Parcel Information layer behind the county parcel/zoning web maps).
license: Summit County GIS (public; disclaimer - verify accuracy)
notes: 43,966 parcels from the COUNTY's authoritative server. For assessor value/built-year/units use the UGRC Parcels_Summit_LIR row instead. Do NOT bulk-download.

description: Scale-dependent cartographic base: parcels, roads, cities, subdivisions, community areas, county boundary, PLSS sections. Reference layer for the county web maps.
notes: Multi-layer cartographic service (subdivisions + community areas useful for growth context).
33,253 points. County addressing base; backs address->parcel lookups.

description: Parcel boundaries joined to county assessor/tax-roll attributes (owner, acreage, market value, year built, building sqft, primary-residence flag, property class) via the statewide Land Information Records schema. The authoritative growth/housing base layer.
publisher: UGRC / Utah SGID (in coordination with the Summit County Assessor)
notes: 37,294 parcels. The housing/growth base: land value, built year, unit counts per parcel. Query by bbox/where; do NOT bulk-download.

description: Parcel boundary polygons only (no tax-roll attributes).
notes: Geometry-only; use the LIR variant unless you only need boundaries.

description: Per-parcel housing unit inventory (unit type, subtype, counts) - the statewide housing-supply/type/density layer. Filter to Summit County.
notes: ~601 Summit records (where COUNTY='SUMMIT'). Housing type/density base for the growth mission.

description: Point locations for every USPS-assigned address in Utah; statewide authoritative geocoding base. Filter to Summit by county field or bbox.
Incorporated municipal boundaries statewide - identifies which land is a city vs unincorporated (the land the COUNTY plans/permits).
notes: Service name 'Municipalities'. Park City / Coalville / Kamas / Oakley / Henefer / Francis vs unincorporated Basin + East Side.

description: Regional GIS downloads for the Mountainland region (Summit + Utah + Wasatch counties) - TAZ/socioeconomic projections, transportation network, aerials, base data.
format: file downloads (shp/gdb/etc. - NOT a queryable REST endpoint)
notes: DOWNLOAD PORTAL, not a REST service - honest note: no per-layer api_endpoint. Summit is one of MAG's 3 member counties. Useful for TAZ / travel-demand / growth projections (cf. a future projections/ module).
